Name: Alex Portrait - CosyAnjalea Style
Author: CosyAnjalea
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
So, I've always wanted to make some sorta portrait mod, and portraiture makes it very easy for me to do so. So here's the Abigail portrait.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1. Download zip.
2. Unzip into stardew valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits
3. Run game, and press the P key, or whatever you set the hotkey as.

[b]Main features[/b]
It's to simply change the character's portrait.

[b]Requirements[/b]
Required mods: Portraiture/PortraiturePlus
